-- WFM observational demand pilot. DOES NOT infer employees, wages or shifts.
-- App source merge does not apply SQL to any existing employer database.
-- DBA must review/run in staging, compare against src/db/schema.ts, then
-- separately approve exact-org feature activation. Do not replay all historical
-- numbered migrations in this repository as an ordered journal.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_demand_import_batches (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  worksite_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES worksites(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_key varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  metric_kind varchar(24) NOT NULL,
  interval_minutes integer NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  request_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  row_count integer NOT NULL,
  created_by_user_id integer REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  imported_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_import_interval_check CHECK (interval_minutes IN (15,30,60)),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_import_count_check CHECK (row_count BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_import_metric_check CHECK
    (metric_kind IN ('transactions','visits','orders','appointments','calls'))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_import_idempotency_unique
  ON workforce_demand_import_batches(organization_id,idempotency_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_import_scope_idx
  ON workforce_demand_import_batches(organization_id,worksite_id,imported_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_demand_observation_revisions (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  worksite_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES worksites(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  import_batch_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES workforce_demand_import_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  source_key varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  metric_kind varchar(24) NOT NULL,
  interval_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
  interval_minutes integer NOT NULL,
  revision integer NOT NULL,
  observed_count integer NOT NULL,
  quality varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_observation_interval_check CHECK (interval_minutes IN (15,30,60)),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_observation_revision_check CHECK (revision BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_observation_count_check CHECK (observed_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_observation_quality_check CHECK
    (quality IN ('complete','partial','unverified')),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_observation_metric_check CHECK
    (metric_kind IN ('transactions','visits','orders','appointments','calls'))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_observation_version_unique
  ON workforce_demand_observation_revisions(
    organization_id,worksite_id,source_key,metric_kind,interval_start,interval_minutes,revision
  );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_observation_history_idx
  ON workforce_demand_observation_revisions(
    organization_id,worksite_id,metric_kind,interval_start
  );

-- These are append-only through the application. A privileged DBA may still
-- make SQL changes, so the UI must never claim cryptographic immutability.
-- Strict tenant and batch consistency is rechecked by the server inside a
-- transaction. Production release must verify indexes/constraints explicitly.

-- WFM staged issued-demand evidence (0113).
-- Depends on the separately reviewed 0112 WFM source-revision schema. The separately draft 0114
-- payout provider is NOT a WFM predecessor or activation requirement. Source merge does not run
-- this DDL in staging or production. There is no ordered Drizzle journal.
-- A DBA must review constraints, verify table ownership and plan rollback.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_demand_forecast_issues (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  worksite_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES worksites(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_key varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  metric_kind varchar(24) NOT NULL,
  interval_minutes integer NOT NULL,
  horizon_days integer NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  request_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  issued_by_user_id integer REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  issued_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  source_cutoff_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  training_evidence_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  snapshot_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  points_count integer NOT NULL,
  snapshot jsonb NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_issued_interval_check CHECK (interval_minutes IN (15,30,60)),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_issued_horizon_check CHECK (horizon_days IN (7,14)),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_issued_points_check CHECK (points_count BETWEEN 1 AND 400),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_issued_hash_check CHECK (
    request_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND training_evidence_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  )
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_issued_key_unique
  ON workforce_demand_forecast_issues(organization_id, idempotency_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_issued_scope_idx
  ON workforce_demand_forecast_issues(organization_id,worksite_id,issued_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_demand_forecast_scores (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  issue_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES workforce_demand_forecast_issues(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  scored_by_user_id integer REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  scored_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  evaluation_cutoff_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  points_count integer NOT NULL,
  report_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  report jsonb NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_score_points_check CHECK (points_count BETWEEN 1 AND 400),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_demand_score_hash_check CHECK (report_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_issued_score_unique
  ON workforce_demand_forecast_scores(issue_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_demand_score_tenant_idx
  ON workforce_demand_forecast_scores(organization_id,scored_at);

-- Application routes only INSERT, never UPDATE/DELETE. This is NOT DBA-proof
-- or cryptographically tamper-evident immutability; qualified operator can
-- alter the database. Retained hashes are reproducibility aids.

-- 0114: governed, versioned WFM demand-to-staffing productivity policies.
-- Applied independently only AFTER DBA-approved 0112 operational demand imports
-- and 0113 issued forecasting. Xendit payout draft must reserve a later number;
-- merging/activating payout is NOT a prerequisite for this WFM release.
-- This file does not run on source merge and there is no ordered Drizzle journal.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_demand_staffing_policies (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  worksite_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES worksites(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  job_profile_id integer REFERENCES job_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  metric_kind varchar(24) NOT NULL,
  interval_minutes integer NOT NULL,
  effective_from date NOT NULL,
  effective_until date NOT NULL,
  version integer NOT NULL,
  productive_units_per_worker_hour numeric(12,4) NOT NULL,
  service_target_coverage_percent numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  rationale varchar(400) NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  content_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  status varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  proposed_by_user_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  submitted_by_user_id integer REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  decided_by_user_id integer REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  submitted_at timestamptz,
  decided_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_metric_check CHECK (metric_kind IN
    ('transactions','visits','orders','appointments','calls')),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_interval_check CHECK (interval_minutes IN (15,30,60)),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_dates_check CHECK (effective_from <= effective_until),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_values_check CHECK (
    productive_units_per_worker_hour BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1000000
    AND service_target_coverage_percent BETWEEN 0.01 AND 100
  ),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_version_check CHECK (version BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_status_check CHECK (
    status IN ('draft','submitted','approved','rejected','superseded')),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_sha_check CHECK (content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_staffing_policy_idempotency_unique
  ON workforce_demand_staffing_policies(organization_id,idempotency_key);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_staffing_policy_scope_version_unique
  ON workforce_demand_staffing_policies(
    organization_id,worksite_id,coalesce(job_profile_id,0),
    metric_kind,interval_minutes,version
  );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_staffing_policy_dates_idx
  ON workforce_demand_staffing_policies(
    organization_id,worksite_id,metric_kind,interval_minutes,
    status,effective_from,effective_until
  );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_demand_staffing_policy_events (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  policy_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES workforce_demand_staffing_policies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  actor_user_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  action varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  policy_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  receipt_sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  prior_policy_id integer REFERENCES workforce_demand_staffing_policies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  decision_note varchar(400) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_event_action_check CHECK (
    action IN ('created','submitted','approved','rejected','superseded')),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_staffing_policy_event_hash_check CHECK (
    policy_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND receipt_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_staffing_policy_event_unique
  ON workforce_demand_staffing_policy_events(policy_id,action);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_staffing_policy_event_scope_idx
  ON workforce_demand_staffing_policy_events(organization_id,policy_id,occurred_at);

-- The application serializes transition decisions per employer in one DB
-- transaction and writes independent audit events in that same transaction.
-- This SQL intentionally does not enable new provider, roster, or payroll flows.
-- A DBA must separately verify live schema prefix, applied-object checksums,
-- ownership, referential integrity and rollback/retention before any deployment.

-- 0115: forward-only recovery of missing payout_profiles objects.
-- Based on the CREATE TABLE/index portion of historical 0074, but this is a
-- NEW reviewed migration, NOT a claim that all 0074 statements ran in main.
-- Predecessors: organizations, legal_entities, bank_templates and users.
-- Bank-template metadata/constraints from 0074 need separate receipt review.
-- Default active=false and bank_file; NO payout account activation or money-out.
-- DRAFT / DO NOT APPLY ON NEON MAIN until source history and restore are approved.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payout_profiles" (
  "id" serial PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "organizations"("id") ON DELETE cascade,
  "legal_entity_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "legal_entities"("id") ON DELETE cascade,
  "bank_template_id" integer REFERENCES "bank_templates"("id") ON DELETE set null,
  "default_method" varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bank_file',
  "bank_product" varchar(120),
  "source_account_type" varchar(32),
  "company_code" varchar(80),
  "presenting_office" varchar(80),
  "branch_code" varchar(32),
  "remarks" varchar(240),
  "max_amount_per_file" numeric(16,2),
  "max_rows_per_file" integer,
  "transaction_limit" numeric(16,2),
  "daily_limit" numeric(16,2),
  "active" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  "created_by_user_id" integer REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE set null,
  "updated_by_user_id" integer REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE set null,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT "payout_profiles_default_method_check" CHECK ("default_method" IN ('bank_file','paymongo','manual')),
  CONSTRAINT "payout_profiles_max_amount_check" CHECK ("max_amount_per_file" IS NULL OR "max_amount_per_file" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "payout_profiles_max_rows_check" CHECK ("max_rows_per_file" IS NULL OR "max_rows_per_file" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "payout_profiles_transaction_limit_check" CHECK ("transaction_limit" IS NULL OR "transaction_limit" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "payout_profiles_daily_limit_check" CHECK ("daily_limit" IS NULL OR "daily_limit" > 0)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "payout_profiles_legal_entity_unique"
  ON "payout_profiles" ("legal_entity_id");

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "payout_profiles_org_active_idx"
  ON "payout_profiles" ("organization_id","active");

-- Additional same-organization invariant. Independent foreign keys only prove
-- a legal entity exists; they do not prove it belongs to profile organization.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_payout_profile_tenant_scope()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM le.id FROM public.legal_entities le
    WHERE le.id = NEW.legal_entity_id
      AND le.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
    FOR SHARE OF le;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYOUT_PROFILE_TENANT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

CREATE TRIGGER payout_profile_tenant_guard
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF organization_id, legal_entity_id
  ON public.payout_profiles FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_payout_profile_tenant_scope();

-- 0116: forward-only PayMongo payout ledger foundation. All payout defaults
-- remain PREPARED; submitting provider transfers is NOT authorized.
-- Incorporates guarded A-2 candidate from draft PR #893 at Git blob
-- 7f02658444930ffbc1074e06bad8a4014faf4bba (source docs/sql/pending-payout-ledger.sql).
-- MUST follow 0115 payout_profiles foundation; later Xendit 0119 depends on
-- all payout_batches/transfers/links and payout_profiles existing.
-- DRAFT / DO NOT APPLY ON NEON MAIN: no verified historical migration journal
-- or witnessed production restore, and broader preceding history still absent.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payout_batches (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payroll_run_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  provider varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paymongo' CHECK (provider = 'paymongo'),
  idempotency_key varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  request_hash varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  transfer_count integer NOT NULL CHECK (transfer_count > 0),
  total_amount_cents bigint NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount_cents > 0),
  status varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared' CHECK (status IN (
    'prepared','submitting','submitted','reconciliation_required','settled','failed','cancelled'
  )),
  provider_batch_id varchar(160),
  claimed_at timestamptz,
  submitted_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_batches_provider_idempotency_unique
  ON payout_batches (provider, idempotency_key);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_batches_remote_batch_unique
  ON payout_batches (provider, provider_batch_id)
  WHERE provider_batch_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_batches_org_run_status_idx
  ON payout_batches (organization_id, payroll_run_id, status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payout_transfers (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payroll_run_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payroll_entry_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_entries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  employee_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES employees(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  reference_number varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  amount_cents bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_cents > 0),
  status varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared' CHECK (status IN (
    'prepared','submitting','submitted','succeeded','failed','reconciliation_required','cancelled'
  )),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_transfers_run_employee_unique
  ON payout_transfers (organization_id, payroll_run_id, employee_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_transfers_run_reference_unique
  ON payout_transfers (payroll_run_id, reference_number);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_transfers_entry_unique
  ON payout_transfers (payroll_entry_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_transfers_org_status_idx
  ON payout_transfers (organization_id, status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payout_batch_transfers (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payout_batch_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES payout_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payout_transfer_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES payout_transfers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  provider_transfer_id varchar(160),
  status varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared' CHECK (status IN (
    'prepared','submitting','submitted','succeeded','failed','reconciliation_required','cancelled'
  )),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_batch_transfers_batch_transfer_unique
  ON payout_batch_transfers (payout_batch_id, payout_transfer_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_batch_transfers_provider_transfer_unique
  ON payout_batch_transfers (provider_transfer_id) WHERE provider_transfer_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_batch_transfers_org_batch_idx
  ON payout_batch_transfers (organization_id, payout_batch_id);

-- A payout's identity and amount must not be rewritten after creation.
-- Adjustments require an independently approved new run, not mutation.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_payout_transfer_identity()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
     OR NEW.payroll_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payroll_run_id
     OR NEW.payroll_entry_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payroll_entry_id
     OR NEW.employee_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.employee_id
     OR NEW.reference_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reference_number
     OR NEW.amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount_cents
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYOUT_IMMUTABLE_TRANSFER_IDENTITY' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'payout_transfers'::regclass
                 AND tgname = 'payout_transfer_identity_guard') THEN
    CREATE TRIGGER payout_transfer_identity_guard
      BEFORE UPDATE ON payout_transfers FOR EACH ROW
      EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_payout_transfer_identity();
  END IF;
END $$;

-- A single provider request's idempotency and frozen total are immutable.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_payout_batch_identity()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
     OR NEW.payroll_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payroll_run_id
     OR NEW.provider IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider
     OR NEW.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.idempotency_key
     OR NEW.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_hash
     OR NEW.transfer_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.transfer_count
     OR NEW.total_amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_amount_cents
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYOUT_IMMUTABLE_BATCH_IDENTITY' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'payout_batches'::regclass
                 AND tgname = 'payout_batch_identity_guard') THEN
    CREATE TRIGGER payout_batch_identity_guard
      BEFORE UPDATE ON payout_batches FOR EACH ROW
      EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_payout_batch_identity();
  END IF;
END $$;

-- DBA acceptance: demonstrate unique constraints and trigger rejection,
-- two-worker claim race, tenant isolation and replay before any rollout.


-- A-2 acceptance gap caught on an isolated Neon clone: independent FKs to
-- org, run, employee and entry do NOT prove that they belong to the same
-- tenant or payroll run. Refuse mismatched references before storing payout
-- identity. These locks keep parent rows stable during the child write.
-- This draft is still NOT a numbered or production-approved migration.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_payout_batch_scope()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM r.id FROM public.payroll_runs r
    WHERE r.id = NEW.payroll_run_id AND r.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
    FOR SHARE OF r;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYOUT_BATCH_TENANT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

CREATE TRIGGER payout_batch_tenant_guard
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF organization_id, payroll_run_id
  ON payout_batches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_payout_batch_scope();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_payout_transfer_scope()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM pe.id FROM public.payroll_entries pe
    JOIN public.payroll_runs r ON r.id = pe.payroll_run_id
    JOIN public.employees e ON e.id = pe.employee_id
  WHERE r.id = NEW.payroll_run_id
    AND pe.id = NEW.payroll_entry_id
    AND e.id = NEW.employee_id
    AND r.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
    AND e.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
  FOR SHARE OF pe, r, e;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYOUT_TRANSFER_TENANT_OR_ENTRY_MISMATCH'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

CREATE TRIGGER payout_transfer_tenant_guard
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF organization_id, payroll_run_id, payroll_entry_id, employee_id
  ON payout_transfers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_payout_transfer_scope();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_payout_batch_transfer_scope()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  PERFORM b.id FROM public.payout_batches b
    JOIN public.payout_transfers t
      ON t.payroll_run_id = b.payroll_run_id
      AND t.organization_id = b.organization_id
  WHERE b.id = NEW.payout_batch_id
    AND t.id = NEW.payout_transfer_id
    AND b.organization_id = NEW.organization_id
  FOR SHARE OF b, t;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYOUT_BATCH_TRANSFER_SCOPE_MISMATCH'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

CREATE TRIGGER payout_batch_transfer_tenant_guard
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF organization_id, payout_batch_id, payout_transfer_id
  ON payout_batch_transfers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_payout_batch_transfer_scope();

-- For full database-level integrity, upstream organization/run/employee
-- reassignment also needs a separate immutability or composite-FK policy.
-- Never call these guards an RLS substitute; no payouts may be submitted.

-- 0118: WFM roster scaling and employer-reviewed schedule-rule policy.
-- SOURCE ONLY. DO NOT APPLY IN PRODUCTION BEFORE DBA AND WFM ACCEPTANCE.
-- Run isolated migration rehearsal before turning WFM_ROSTER_SCALE_RULES_ENABLED on.
-- The indexed scan uses the existing assignment primary key as a keyset cursor.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workforce_roster_rule_policies (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id integer NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  max_daily_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 720,
  max_rolling_seven_day_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 2880,
  min_rest_between_shifts_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 660,
  ordinary_daily_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 480,
  approved_overtime_cap_minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  enforcement_mode varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'block',
  updated_by_user_id integer REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT wfm_roster_rules_limits_check CHECK (
    max_daily_minutes BETWEEN 480 AND 1440
    AND max_rolling_seven_day_minutes BETWEEN 480 AND 10080
    AND min_rest_between_shifts_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1440
    AND ordinary_daily_minutes BETWEEN 480 AND 720
    AND approved_overtime_cap_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 10080
    AND enforcement_mode IN ('block', 'advisory')
  )
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS wfm_roster_rules_org_idx ON workforce_roster_rule_policies (organization_id);

-- Issue #1015: candidate for an independently reviewed, FORWARD-ONLY repair.
-- SOURCE ONLY: not an applied migration, approval, historical receipt, or
-- authorization to enable real payroll/payout features.
--
-- Existing 0067 and 0088 are historic SQL and MUST NOT be silently replayed.
-- This candidate creates only the ABSENT final attendance exception relation.
-- It is blocked by the protected release runner until the DBA establishes:
--   (1) full historical path+SHA receipts and a protected cutover boundary,
--   (2) all preceding forward migration receipts (0123 and earlier),
--   (3) verified target and role, approved backup+offline restore, DBA review.
-- No application rows are read, updated, deleted, backfilled or copied.
-- No IF NOT EXISTS: an existing/drifted target requires independent review.
DO $issue1015_attendance_preflight$
DECLARE
  missing_or_invalid_parents text;
BEGIN
  IF pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.attendance_exception_events') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1015_EXISTING_ATTENDANCE_RELATION_REQUIRES_MANUAL_REVIEW'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(required.name, ', ' ORDER BY required.name)
    INTO missing_or_invalid_parents
  FROM (VALUES
    ('organizations'), ('employees'), ('users'), ('time_punches')
  ) AS required(name)
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ns ON ns.nspname = 'public'
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class parent
    ON parent.relnamespace = ns.oid
    AND parent.relname = required.name AND parent.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute id
    ON id.attrelid = parent.oid AND id.attname = 'id'
    AND id.attnum > 0 AND NOT id.attisdropped
  WHERE parent.oid IS NULL
     OR id.atttypid IS NULL
     OR pg_catalog.format_type(id.atttypid, id.atttypmod) <> 'integer'
     OR NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint pk
       WHERE pk.conrelid = parent.oid AND pk.contype = 'p'
         AND pg_catalog.array_length(pk.conkey, 1) = 1
         AND pk.conkey[1] = id.attnum
     );

  IF missing_or_invalid_parents IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1015_PARENT_INTEGER_PK_MISSING_OR_DRIFTED: %',
      missing_or_invalid_parents USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- An interrupted historical DDL may leave the SERIAL sequence or a name
  -- reserved on a different table even when the target relation is absent.
  -- Refuse that partial namespace state BEFORE any new DDL is attempted.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class object
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = object.relnamespace
    WHERE ns.nspname = 'public'
      AND object.relname = ANY (ARRAY[
        'attendance_exception_events_id_seq',
        'attendance_exception_events_pkey',
        'attendance_exception_events_fingerprint_unique',
        'attendance_exception_events_open_idx',
        'attendance_exception_events_employee_idx',
        'attendance_exception_events_owner_idx',
        'attendance_exception_events_sla_idx'
      ])
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1015_ORPHANED_ATTENDANCE_SCHEMA_OBJECT_REQUIRES_MANUAL_REVIEW'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
END

-- table creation and the protected runner's forward-migration journal insert.
-- Catch incomplete DDL before a committed journal entry could claim success.
-- A separate, independent 36-object read-only postflight is still mandatory.
DO $issue1015_attendance_postflight$
DECLARE
  target_oid oid := pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.attendance_exception_events');
  column_count integer;
  named_index_count integer;
  foreign_key_count integer;
  named_check_count integer;
  primary_key_count integer;
BEGIN
  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO column_count
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  WHERE a.attrelid = target_oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped;

  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO named_index_count
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_index ix
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class idx ON idx.oid = ix.indexrelid
  WHERE ix.indrelid = target_oid AND ix.indisvalid AND ix.indisready
    AND (
      (idx.relname = 'attendance_exception_events_fingerprint_unique' AND ix.indisunique)
      OR (idx.relname = ANY (ARRAY[
        'attendance_exception_events_open_idx',
        'attendance_exception_events_employee_idx',
        'attendance_exception_events_owner_idx',
        'attendance_exception_events_sla_idx'
      ]) AND NOT ix.indisunique)
    );

  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO foreign_key_count
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
  WHERE c.conrelid = target_oid AND c.contype = 'f' AND c.convalidated;

  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO named_check_count
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
  WHERE c.conrelid = target_oid AND c.contype = 'c' AND c.convalidated
    AND c.conname = ANY (ARRAY[
      'attendance_exception_events_severity_check',
      'attendance_exception_events_status_check'
    ]);

  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO primary_key_count
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
  WHERE c.conrelid = target_oid AND c.contype = 'p' AND c.convalidated;

  IF target_oid IS NULL
     OR column_count <> 23 OR named_index_count <> 5
     OR foreign_key_count <> 5 OR named_check_count <> 2
     OR primary_key_count <> 1 THEN

      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';

-- NOT a production apply authorization. Do not replay 0039 or use db:push.
-- Reviewed migration runner owns transaction and authentic checksum/receipt.
-- Fail closed on missing prerequisites or partially installed relations.
DO $issue1054_preflight$
DECLARE missing_objects text;
BEGIN
  SELECT string_agg(object_name, ', ' ORDER BY object_name)
    INTO missing_objects
  FROM (VALUES
    ('public.organizations'), ('public.employees'), ('public.users'),
    ('public.worksites'), ('public.shift_definitions'),
    ('public.job_profiles'), ('public.staffing_requirements')
  ) AS required(object_name)
  WHERE to_regclass(object_name) IS NULL;

  IF missing_objects IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1054_MISSING_PREREQUISITES: %', missing_objects
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- An index name alone is not evidence of role-scoped uniqueness. Refuse
  -- a swapped/wrong-key index even when it uses the expected historical name.
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class idx ON idx.oid = i.indexrelid
    WHERE idx.oid = to_regclass('public.staffing_requirement_role_unique')
      AND i.indrelid = to_regclass('public.staffing_requirements')
      AND i.indisunique AND i.indisvalid AND i.indisready
      AND pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) ILIKE
        '%(organization_id, worksite_id, work_date, shift_definition_id, COALESCE(job_profile_id, 0))%'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1054_STAFFING_ROLE_INDEX_NOT_FOUND'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.staffing_requirement_unique') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1054_LEGACY_STAFFING_UNIQUENESS_PRESENT'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';

  IF to_regclass('public.employee_availability_rules') IS NOT NULL
     OR to_regclass('public.open_shifts') IS NOT NULL
     OR to_regclass('public.open_shift_claims') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ISSUE1054_PARTIAL_OR_EXISTING_SCHEMA_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';

END $issue1054_preflight$;

DECLARE
  drifted_parent_names text;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = ANY (ARRAY[
      'compensation_bands','compensation_cycles','compensation_proposals',
      'compensation_components','employee_compensation_components','compensation_events'
    ])
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMP1061_PARTIAL_OR_EXISTING_COMPENSATION_SCHEMA'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(required.name, ', ' ORDER BY required.name)
  INTO drifted_parent_names
  FROM (VALUES
    ('organizations'), ('users'), ('employees'), ('job_profiles'),
    ('job_grades'), ('legal_entities'), ('worker_effective_changes'),
    ('employee_pay_revisions')
  ) AS required(name)
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.nspname = 'public'
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class parent
    ON parent.relnamespace = n.oid
    AND parent.relname = required.name AND parent.relkind IN ('r','p')
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute id
    ON id.attrelid = parent.oid AND id.attname = 'id'
    AND id.attnum > 0 AND NOT id.attisdropped
  WHERE parent.oid IS NULL
    OR id.atttypid IS NULL
    OR pg_catalog.format_type(id.atttypid, id.atttypmod) <> 'integer'
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint pk
      WHERE pk.conrelid = parent.oid AND pk.contype = 'p'
        AND pg_catalog.array_length(pk.conkey, 1) = 1
        AND pk.conkey[1] = id.attnum
    );

  IF drifted_parent_names IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMP1061_MISSING_OR_DRIFTED_PARENT_INTEGER_PK: %',
      drifted_parent_names USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- An interrupted historical attempt can leave sequences or indexes even
  -- where target tables were dropped. Refuse the ambiguous state up front.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = ANY (ARRAY[
      'compensation_bands_id_seq','compensation_bands_pkey',

      'compensation_bands_org_grade_idx','compensation_bands_org_legal_entity_idx',

      'compensation_proposals_cycle_employee_unique',
      'compensation_proposals_org_status_idx',
      'compensation_components_id_seq','compensation_components_pkey',
      'compensation_components_org_code_unique','compensation_components_org_name_unique',
      'compensation_components_org_active_idx',
      'employee_compensation_components_id_seq','employee_compensation_components_pkey',
      'employee_comp_components_active_idx','employee_comp_components_employee_date_idx',

-- must check exact columns, key orders, defaults and FK targets before release.
DO $comp1061_postflight$
DECLARE
  incomplete_count integer;
BEGIN
  WITH expected(table_name, cols, fks, indexes) AS (
    VALUES
      ('compensation_bands',16,5,6),
      ('compensation_cycles',12,2,3),
      ('compensation_proposals',19,8,3),
      ('compensation_components',13,2,4),
      ('employee_compensation_components',20,6,4),
      ('compensation_events',17,7,3)
  )
  SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) INTO incomplete_count
  FROM expected e
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.nspname = 'public'
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.relnamespace = n.oid
    AND t.relname = e.table_name AND t.relkind IN ('r','p')
  WHERE t.oid IS NULL
    OR (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
        WHERE a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) <> e.cols
    OR (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        WHERE c.conrelid = t.oid AND c.contype = 'f' AND c.convalidated) <> e.fks
    OR (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_index ix
        WHERE ix.indrelid = t.oid AND ix.indisvalid AND ix.indisready) <> e.indexes
    OR (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
        WHERE c.conrelid = t.oid AND c.contype = 'p' AND c.convalidated) <> 1;

  IF incomplete_count <> 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMP1061_POSTFLIGHT_INCOMPLETE_FINAL_COMPENSATION_SCHEMA'

END

# Database schema

**Production release warning:** the application currently still executes
compatibility DDL and backfills through `src/lib/core-schema-compat.ts`.
That is a separate unresolved P0-4 risk, not a supported migration executor.
The SQL files here are not a single ordered sequence; read this before running anything.
A DBA must reconcile production history before disabling runtime writers.

**New P0-4 source-only transition:** `scripts/run-reviewed-migration.mjs` now
provides an independent, manually approved, checksum-backed **forward-only**
executor **after** a DBA adopts a verified historical prefix. It does not
replay this folder, replace `db:push` for synthetic CI, or turn off runtime
compatibility DDL automatically. The historic receipts, a reviewed cutover
manifest, a separate applied migration journal, sanitized clone rehearsal and
protected manual release environment are mandatory. See
[`reviewed-migration-runner.md`](../docs/engineering/reviewed-migration-runner.md).

## A fresh **disposable development or CI** database

```
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://localhost/..." npm run db:push
```

**Never use `db:push` against production to repair drift.** Use the DBA-reviewed
schema and receipt protocol for staging and production.

**Fresh PostgreSQL 18 first-bootstrap acceptance:** The [guarded PG18 development journey](../docs/engineering/fresh-pg18-dev-rebuild-20261014.md) exercises a verified empty localhost database, its strict first source-schema push, and a fictional Hire-to-filing workflow in the PostgreSQL 18 governed-Hire matrix case (with PostgreSQL 16 direct/governed cases). This does not replay archived migrations or authorize production activity. The default Drizzle 0.x repeat-push defect described below remains blocked; the separate CI-only matched-RC repeat-push proof is not an application runtime upgrade.

**Current Drizzle 0.x limitation (October 2026):** the pinned development
toolchain (`drizzle-kit@0.31.11` / `drizzle-orm@0.45.4`) can emit a
phantom `DROP CONSTRAINT documents_org_employee_id_hr_cases_unique` on a
*second* push to an unchanged PostgreSQL 18 schema. PostgreSQL refuses
because the existing `employee_hr_cases_coe_document_tenant_fk` depends on
the unique key. A successful first push or process exit code 0 does **not**
prove a safe, idempotent second push. Do not use `--force`, `CASCADE`, or
weaken the composite tenant/employee FK to make it pass.

**#1019 fail-closed wrapper:** `npm run db:push` now invokes
`scripts/strict-db-push.mjs`, preserving the existing local/CI-only target
guard while checking Drizzle's **stdout, stderr, AND exit code**. It rejects
PostgreSQL `2BP01`, interactive errors, ambiguous output, and a claimed
`No changes detected` result accompanied by DDL, even when the underlying
CLI exits zero. A valid result is summarized without printing SQL or credentials.
The pinned Drizzle 0.31.x **diff bug is not solved by this wrapper**:
a second push may correctly FAIL instead of silently reporting success.

The PG18 CI workflow separately experiments with the matched Drizzle v1 RC
in its **disposable worker only**. Its zero-change result and read-only
catalog fingerprint, plus a fictional same-tenant / cross-tenant COE FK
acceptance in a transaction that rolls back, are prerequisites for evaluating
a compatible upstream version. Do not update runtime Drizzle packages or
close #1019 merely because a strict wrapper or RC-only job passed.

The isolated `pg18-schema-repeat-proof.yml` CI workflow can exercise
**matched** `drizzle-kit@1.0.0-rc.4` and `drizzle-orm@1.0.0-rc.4` against
a newly created, disposable PG18 `app_db`, verify the real composite FK,
require a strict no-change second push, and compare PostgreSQL catalog
fingerprints. Those pre-release packages are installed **only in the CI
worker**, with `--no-save --package-lock=false`. They are **not** approved
for the application runtime: the RC introduces breaking driver APIs and fails
this repository's TypeScript typecheck until the runtime and tests are
migrated. An eventual version upgrade also requires separately reviewed
historical migration compatibility and production release gates.



`db:push` reads `src/db/schema.ts` and creates everything it finds there, which
is the whole current schema. **Check that it actually created tables**: push has
been seen to report success and create nothing against a non-standard Postgres.
Compare the created tables with `src/db/schema.ts`; the count changes as features
are added. Do not use the historical `baseline.sql` as a replacement for the
current schema. It omits tables and columns introduced after it was generated.

## The files

- `baseline.sql` is a historical schema snapshot generated from an older
  `src/db/schema.ts`. It is deliberately unnumbered: it is a starting point for
  an empty database, not the next step in the numbered sequence below.
- `0001_payroll_periods_rbac.sql` and `0002_final_pay_reconciliation.sql` are
  historical increments from before the baseline existed. Their changes are
  already folded into `baseline.sql`, so applying them on top of it will fail on
  objects that already exist. They are kept for the history of a database that
  was migrated step by step.

There is no `meta/_journal.json`, so `drizzle-kit migrate` is not the workflow
here. Use `db:push` for schema changes, and `npm run db:generate` if you want to
review the SQL a schema change would produce before applying it.

## First account

Once the schema exists, visit `/setup` to create the owner account. That route
only works while the instance has no users; `POST /api/setup` returns 409 after
the first one, so it closes itself.

- `0021_performance_management.sql` adds the HCM performance foundation: cycles, employee goals, and formal reviews.

- `0022_job_architecture_positions.sql` adds job profiles, workforce plans, positions, and effective-dated position assignments.

## Compensation outbox: governed staging migration

The retained SQL for the durable compensation automation outbox is
`0100_compensation_automation_intents.sql` (not the older proposed
`0099_compensation_automation_intents.sql`). Main also uses migration number
0099 for talent/requisition skills, so the distinct 0100 name prevents
ambiguous version labels. This repository still does **not** have an ordered
Drizzle migration journal; numbered files must not be automatically replayed
as an incremental migration sequence.

Before enabling the compensation salary/application worker on an existing
staging database, have a DBA independently review and apply the approved SQL,
then run `npm run compensation:release:schema:check` using an explicitly
selected read-only database credential. It validates the live table, indexes,
foreign keys and status constraints, with fail-closed return codes. CI also
rehearses the SQL transactionally in a disposable local schema; the rehearsal
cannot establish that a real employer's staging schema has been migrated.

See [Compensation staging release gate](../docs/compensation-staging-release-gate.md).
## Tamper-evident audit trail (0109)

`0109_tamper_evident_audit_chain.sql` installs a trigger and SQL functions,
which `db:push` does not create. Apply it with `psql -f` (it is idempotent)
after the schema exists. It rejects UPDATE/DELETE on `audit_events` (except
cascades from an organization deletion), and `seal_audit_events()` appends
committed rows to a per-organization SHA-256 chain. Inserts take no locks; the
scheduler and the verifier seal pending rows. Verify a workspace with
`GET /api/compliance/audit-chain?organizationId=…`.

Do not run `db:push` or paste a historical baseline into a production
employer database without a separate signed, reviewed migration and rollback
plan. Neither schema compatibility nor CI supplies payroll GA authorization.

## Provider webhook event inbox (0110)

`0110_provider_events_inbox.sql` follows the 0109 tamper-evident audit-chain migration. It creates the `provider_events` table with a unique `(provider,event_id)` index and organization/run foreign keys. Apply via a controlled, journaled staging/production SQL release after verifying 0109 and a backup/rollback plan. It is **not** applied by the source merge. Signed PayMongo webhooks return a retryable 503 if the inbox transaction cannot persist an event, including when the schema is missing. Test concurrent replays before activating live PayMongo payouts.

## Receipt audit before production migration

The protected read-only receipt audit in
`docs/engineering/production-migration-receipt-runbook.md` hashes every numbered
file by full path, preserves legacy duplicate prefixes, and checks separately
reviewed DBA receipts. It never runs this historical SQL. The unnumbered
`baseline.sql` and any previous `db:push` state need independent adoption proof.

  "reason" varchar(240) NOT NULL,
  "requested_by_user_id" integer REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE set null,

  "activated_at" timestamptz,

-- Decisions never auto-regularize, auto-renew, or auto-separate a worker.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hcm_employment_term_decisions" (
  "id" serial PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "organizations"("id") ON DELETE cascade,
  "employee_id" integer NOT NULL REFERENCES "employees"("id") ON DELETE cascade,

    "decision_kind" IN ('confirm_regular','renew_term','extend_term','convert_terms','non_renew','continue_current')
  ),
  "effective_date" date NOT NULL,
  "next_employment_type" varchar(32),
  "next_term_kind" varchar(24),
  "next_effective_until" date,
  "next_probation_review_date" date,
  "next_contract_end_date" date,
  "next_project_name" varchar(160),

    CHECK ("status" IN ('pending_approval','scheduled','applied','cancelled','failed')),
  "separation_handoff_status" varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
    CHECK ("separation_handoff_status" IN ('none','ready','started','completed')),

  "applied_at" timestamptz,

  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "failure" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT "hcm_employment_term_decision_valid_next_range" CHECK (
    "next_effective_until" IS NULL OR "next_effective_until" >= "effective_date"
  ),

-- HCM Core 3.2: authoritative linkage from non-renewal decisions into Separation.
-- Handoff state advances only through the real separation/final-pay workflow.

ALTER TABLE "hcm_employment_term_decisions"
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "separation_record_id" integer REFERENCES "separation_records"("id") ON DELETE restrict,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "separation_handoff_started_at" timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "separation_handoff_completed_at" timestamptz;

-- Core 3.1 allowed manual handoff status markers before an authoritative separation
-- record existed. Normalize any such legacy markers back to ready so they must be
-- revalidated through the actual Separation workflow.
UPDATE "hcm_employment_term_decisions"
SET
  "separation_handoff_status" = 'ready',
  "separation_handoff_started_at" = NULL,
  "separation_handoff_completed_at" = NULL
WHERE "decision_kind" = 'non_renew'
  AND "status" = 'applied'
  AND "separation_handoff_status" IN ('started','completed')
  AND "separation_record_id" IS NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "hcm_employment_term_decisions_separation_unique"
  ON "hcm_employment_term_decisions" ("separation_record_id")
  WHERE "separation_record_id" IS NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE "hcm_employment_term_decisions"
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "hcm_employment_term_decision_separation_link_valid";

ALTER TABLE "hcm_employment_term_decisions"
  ADD CONSTRAINT "hcm_employment_term_decision_separation_link_valid" CHECK (
    (
      "separation_handoff_status" IN ('none','ready')
      AND "separation_record_id" IS NULL
      AND "separation_handoff_started_at" IS NULL
      AND "separation_handoff_completed_at" IS NULL
    )
    OR
    (
      "separation_handoff_status" = 'started'
      AND "decision_kind" = 'non_renew'
      AND "separation_record_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "separation_handoff_started_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "separation_handoff_completed_at" IS NULL
    )
    OR
    (
      "separation_handoff_status" = 'completed'
      AND "decision_kind" = 'non_renew'
      AND "separation_record_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "separation_handoff_started_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "separation_handoff_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
    )
  );

-- Backfill a minimal immutable timeline for decisions that predate Core 3.5.
INSERT INTO "hcm_employment_decision_events" (
  "organization_id","decision_id","employee_id","event_type","actor_user_id","actor_name","metadata","created_at"
)
SELECT d."organization_id",d."id",d."employee_id",'requested',d."requested_by_user_id",d."requested_by",
  jsonb_build_object('backfilled', true, 'decisionKind', d."decision_kind", 'effectiveDate', d."effective_date"),
  d."created_at"
FROM "hcm_employment_term_decisions" d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "hcm_employment_decision_events" e
  WHERE e."decision_id" = d."id" AND e."event_type" = 'requested'
);

INSERT INTO "hcm_employment_decision_events" (
  "organization_id","decision_id","employee_id","event_type","actor_user_id","actor_name","metadata","created_at"
)
SELECT d."organization_id",d."id",d."employee_id",'approved',d."approved_by_user_id",COALESCE(d."approved_by",'Unknown approver'),
  jsonb_build_object('backfilled', true),d."approved_at"
FROM "hcm_employment_term_decisions" d
WHERE d."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "hcm_employment_decision_events" e
  WHERE e."decision_id" = d."id" AND e."event_type" = 'approved'
);

INSERT INTO "hcm_employment_decision_events" (
  "organization_id","decision_id","employee_id","event_type","actor_user_id","actor_name","metadata","created_at"
)
SELECT d."organization_id",d."id",d."employee_id",'applied',
  COALESCE(d."approved_by_user_id",d."requested_by_user_id"),
  COALESCE(d."approved_by",d."requested_by",'System'),
  jsonb_build_object('backfilled', true, 'successorTermId', d."successor_term_id", 'separationHandoffStatus', d."separation_handoff_status"),
  d."applied_at"
FROM "hcm_employment_term_decisions" d
WHERE d."applied_at" IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "hcm_employment_decision_events" e
  WHERE e."decision_id" = d."id" AND e."event_type" = 'applied'
);

INSERT INTO "hcm_employment_decision_events" (
  "organization_id","decision_id","employee_id","event_type","actor_user_id","actor_name","metadata","created_at"
)
SELECT d."organization_id",d."id",d."employee_id",'cancelled',d."cancelled_by_user_id",COALESCE(d."cancelled_by",'Unknown actor'),
  jsonb_build_object('backfilled', true),d."cancelled_at"
FROM "hcm_employment_term_decisions" d
WHERE d."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "hcm_employment_decision_events" e
  WHERE e."decision_id" = d."id" AND e."event_type" = 'cancelled'
);

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "job_profile_id" integer REFERENCES "job_profiles"("id") ON DELETE set null,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "skill_id" integer REFERENCES "hcm_skills"("id") ON DELETE set null,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "expected_proficiency" integer,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "required" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "weight" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

UPDATE "performance_review_items" AS pri
SET
  "required" = pct."required",
  "weight" = pct."weight"
FROM "performance_reviews" AS pr,
     "performance_cycle_templates" AS pct
WHERE pri."review_id" = pr."id"
  AND pri."organization_id" = pr."organization_id"
  AND pct."cycle_id" = pr."cycle_id"
  AND pct."template_id" = pri."template_id"
  AND pct."organization_id" = pri."organization_id";

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "dynamic_group_id" integer REFERENCES "dynamic_worker_groups"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,

  ON "user_permission_assignments" ("organization_id", "dynamic_group_id");

DO $guard$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'user_permission_assignments_group_pair_check'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE "user_permission_assignments"
      ADD CONSTRAINT "user_permission_assignments_group_pair_check"
      CHECK (
        ("dynamic_group_id" IS NULL AND "dynamic_group_version" IS NULL) OR
        ("dynamic_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dynamic_group_version" >= 1)
      );
  END IF;
END $guard$;

export const userOrganizations = pgTable(

    workerEmployeeId: integer("worker_employee_id").references(() => employees.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    active: boolean("active").notNull().default(true),

    uniqueIndex("user_org_unique").on(table.userId, table.organizationId),
    uniqueIndex("user_org_worker_employee_unique").on(table.organizationId, table.workerEmployeeId)
      .where(sql`${table.workerEmployeeId} is not null`),

/** A4 evidence is separate: legacy expense reads/writes need no new columns. */
export const expenseClaimEvidence = pgTable("expense_claim_evidence", {
  claimId: integer("claim_id").primaryKey().references(() => expenseClaims.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  employeeId: integer("employee_id").notNull().references(() => employees.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  categoryPolicyId: integer("category_policy_id").notNull(),
  taxable: boolean("taxable").notNull(),
  approvedAmount: numeric("approved_amount", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }),
  approvedByUserId: integer("approved_by_user_id").references(() => users.id),
  approvedAt: timestamp("approved_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  receiptStorageKey: varchar("receipt_storage_key", { length: 512 }),
  receiptSha256: varchar("receipt_sha256", { length: 64 }),
  receiptByteSize: integer("receipt_byte_size"),
  receiptVerifiedAt: timestamp("receipt_verified_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  receiptMime: varchar("receipt_mime", { length: 100 }),
  receiptFileName: varchar("receipt_file_name", { length: 200 }),
  receiptScanNote: varchar("receipt_scan_note", { length: 240 }),
}, table => [
  foreignKey({ name: "expense_evidence_claim_employer_fk",
    columns: [table.organizationId, table.employeeId, table.claimId],
    foreignColumns: [expenseClaims.organizationId, expenseClaims.employeeId, expenseClaims.id],
  }).onDelete("cascade"),
  foreignKey({ name: "expense_evidence_policy_employer_fk",
    columns: [table.organizationId, table.categoryPolicyId],
    foreignColumns: [expenseCategoryPolicies.organizationId, expenseCategoryPolicies.id],
  }),
  check("expense_evidence_amount_check", sql`${table.approvedAmount} is null or ${table.approvedAmount} > 0`),
  check("expense_evidence_receipt_size_check", sql`${table.receiptByteSize} is null or ${table.receiptByteSize} between 1 and 5242880`),
  uniqueIndex("expense_evidence_receipt_key_unique").on(table.receiptStorageKey).where(sql`${table.receiptStorageKey} is not null`),
  uniqueIndex("expense_evidence_receipt_tenant_hash_unique").on(table.organizationId, table.receiptSha256)
    .where(sql`${table.receiptSha256} is not null`),
]);

/**
 * Reviewed, one-time historic basic-pay underpayment claims.
 * An approval posts a separately settled taxable earning in a future cutoff.
 * Historical released runs and current base-pay profiles remain immutable.
 */
export const payrollUnderpaymentRequests = pgTable(
  "payroll_underpayment_requests",
  {
    id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
    organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    employeeId: integer("employee_id").notNull().references(() => employees.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    sourcePayrollRunId: integer("source_payroll_run_id").notNull().references(() => payrollRuns.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    sourcePayrollEntryId: integer("source_payroll_entry_id").notNull().references(() => payrollEntries.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    sourceEntryHash: varchar("source_entry_hash", { length: 64 }).notNull(),
    amount: numeric("amount", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }).notNull(),
    effectiveDate: date("effective_date").notNull(),
    reason: varchar("reason", { length: 500 }).notNull(),
    evidenceReference: varchar("evidence_reference", { length: 200 }).notNull(),
    status: varchar("status", { length: 24 }).notNull().default("pending_review"),
    requestedByUserId: integer("requested_by_user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    requestedBy: varchar("requested_by", { length: 120 }).notNull(),
    reviewedByUserId: integer("reviewed_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    reviewedBy: varchar("reviewed_by", { length: 120 }),
    reviewedAt: timestamp("reviewed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    reviewReason: varchar("review_reason", { length: 500 }),
    postedEarningId: integer("posted_earning_id").unique().references(() => supplementaryEarnings.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (table) => [
    index("payroll_underpayment_requests_org_status_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.status, table.createdAt),
    uniqueIndex("payroll_underpayment_one_source_unique").on(table.organizationId, table.employeeId, table.sourcePayrollRunId)
      .where(sql`${table.status} in ('pending_review','posted')`),
    check("payroll_underpayment_amount_check", sql`${table.amount} > 0 and ${table.amount} <= 1000000`),
    check("payroll_underpayment_status_check", sql`${table.status} in ('pending_review','posted','rejected')`),
    check("payroll_underpayment_posted_consistency_check",
      sql`(${table.status} = 'posted' and ${table.postedEarningId} is not null and ${table.reviewedByUserId} is not null)
        or (${table.status} <> 'posted' and ${table.postedEarningId} is null)`),
  ],
);

export const documents = pgTable("documents", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  employeeId: integer("employee_id").references(() => employees.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  kind: varchar("kind", { length: 40 }).notNull(),
  fileName: varchar("file_name", { length: 200 }).notNull(),
  mimeType: varchar("mime_type", { length: 100 }).notNull(),
  byteSize: integer("byte_size").notNull(),
  sha256: varchar("sha256", { length: 64 }).notNull(),
  scannedClean: boolean("scanned_clean").notNull().default(false),
  scanNote: varchar("scan_note", { length: 200 }).notNull().default(""),
  sourceType: varchar("source_type", { length: 24 }).notNull().default("upload"),
  sourceKey: varchar("source_key", { length: 160 }),
  generationMetadata: jsonb("generation_metadata").notNull().default({}),
  uploadedBy: varchar("uploaded_by", { length: 120 }).notNull(),
  // Human uploader provenance is required for the gated independent HR checker.
  // Historical names cannot be silently promoted to a trusted user identity.
  uploadedByUserId: integer("uploaded_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  // A-5: null for historical Postgres-backed documents. New scanned uploads
  // store a private object key and an empty legacy content sentinel.
  // Historical base64 is migrated separately with verified hashes and legal holds.
  objectStorageKey: varchar("object_storage_key", { length: 512 }),
  content: text("content").notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  uniqueIndex("documents_org_source_key_unique")
    .on(table.organizationId, table.sourceKey)
    .where(sql`${table.sourceKey} is not null`),
  index("documents_org_employee_source_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.employeeId, table.sourceType, table.createdAt),
  uniqueIndex("documents_object_storage_key_unique").on(table.objectStorageKey).where(sql`${table.objectStorageKey} is not null`),
  // Composite parent key prevents a COE in another employer from being attached to an HR case.
  unique("documents_org_employee_id_hr_cases_unique").on(table.organizationId, table.employeeId, table.id),
  check("documents_source_type_check", sql`${table.sourceType} in ('upload','generated')`),
]);

export const employeeLoans = pgTable("employee_loans", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  employeeId: integer("employee_id").notNull().references(() => employees.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  loanType: varchar("loan_type", { length: 64 }).notNull(), // "SSS Salary Loan", "Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose Loan", "Company Emergency Loan", etc.
  referenceNo: varchar("reference_no", { length: 64 }).notNull(),
  principal: numeric("principal", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }).notNull(),
  monthlyAmortization: numeric("monthly_amortization", { precision: 10, scale: 2 }).notNull(),
  cutoffDeduction: numeric("cutoff_deduction", { precision: 10, scale: 2 }).notNull(),
  remainingBalance: numeric("remaining_balance", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }).notNull(),
  totalPaid: numeric("total_paid", { precision: 12, scale: 2 }).notNull().default("0"),
  // Newly registered loans are inert until a different payroll checker
  // reviews the employer/agency deduction authorization. Pre-existing active
  // loans retain their statuses and require historical evidence review.
  status: varchar("status", { length: 32 }).notNull().default("pending_approval"),
  requestedByUserId: integer("requested_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  reviewedByUserId: integer("reviewed_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  reviewedAt: timestamp("reviewed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  deductionAuthorizationReference: varchar("deduction_authorization_reference", { length: 200 }),
  reviewEvidenceReference: varchar("review_evidence_reference", { length: 200 }),
  reviewReason: varchar("review_reason", { length: 500 }),
  startDate: date("startDate"),
  endDate: date("endDate"),
  notes: text("notes"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  index("employee_loans_org_status_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.status, table.id),
  check("employee_loans_independent_deduction_check", sql`
    ${table.requestedByUserId} is null
    or ${table.status} not in ('active', 'paused', 'paid_off')
    or (${table.reviewedByUserId} is not null
      and ${table.requestedByUserId} <> ${table.reviewedByUserId}
      and ${table.reviewedAt} is not null
      and ${table.reviewEvidenceReference} is not null
      and length(trim(${table.reviewEvidenceReference})) >= 8)
  `),
]);

/**
 * Maker/checker WFM batch requests. This is not the published roster:
 * approved schedule_overrides remain the payroll-facing source of truth.
 * Bulk execution is server-flagged OFF until staging, DBA and release sign-off.
 */
export const workforceRosterBatches = pgTable(
  "workforce_roster_batches",
  {
    id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
    organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    workDate: date("work_date").notNull(),
    shiftDefinitionId: integer("shift_definition_id").notNull().references(() => shiftDefinitions.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    employeeIds: jsonb("employee_ids").notNull(),
    evidenceSha256: varchar("evidence_sha256", { length: 64 }).notNull(),
    requestSha256: varchar("request_sha256", { length: 64 }).notNull(),
    idempotencyKey: varchar("idempotency_key", { length: 80 }).notNull(),
    reason: varchar("reason", { length: 240 }).notNull(),
    status: varchar("status", { length: 24 }).notNull().default("pending"),
    requestedByUserId: integer("requested_by_user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    requestedByName: varchar("requested_by_name", { length: 120 }).notNull(),
    requestedAt: timestamp("requested_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    decidedByUserId: integer("decided_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    decidedByName: varchar("decided_by_name", { length: 120 }),
    decidedAt: timestamp("decided_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    decisionNote: varchar("decision_note", { length: 240 }),
    overrideIds: jsonb("override_ids").notNull().default([]),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (table) => [
    uniqueIndex("wfm_roster_batches_idempotency_unique")
      .on(table.organizationId, table.requestedByUserId, table.idempotencyKey),
    index("wfm_roster_batches_review_idx")
      .on(table.organizationId, table.status, table.workDate, table.id),
    check("wfm_roster_batches_status_check",
      sql`${table.status} in ('pending','approved','rejected','stale')`),
    check("wfm_roster_batches_employees_check",
      sql`jsonb_typeof(${table.employeeIds}) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(${table.employeeIds}) between 1 and 20`),
    check("wfm_roster_batches_maker_checker_check",
      sql`${table.decidedByUserId} is null or ${table.decidedByUserId} <> ${table.requestedByUserId}`),
    check("wfm_roster_batches_decision_check",
      sql`(${table.status} = 'pending' and ${table.decidedAt} is null and ${table.decidedByUserId} is null)
        or (${table.status} <> 'pending' and ${table.decidedAt} is not null and ${table.decidedByUserId} is not null)`),
  ],
);

    effectiveUntil: date("effective_until").notNull(),
    version: integer("version").notNull(),
    productiveUnitsPerWorkerHour: numeric("productive_units_per_worker_hour", { precision: 12, scale: 4 }).notNull(),
    serviceTargetCoveragePercent: numeric("service_target_coverage_percent", { precision: 5, scale: 2 }).notNull(),

    check("wfm_staffing_policy_status_check", sql`${t.status} in ('draft','submitted','approved','rejected','superseded')`),
    check("wfm_staffing_policy_sha_check", sql`${t.contentSha256} ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'`),

 */
export const legalEntityStatutoryRegistrations = pgTable("legal_entity_statutory_registrations", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  legalEntityId: integer("legal_entity_id").notNull().references(() => legalEntities.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  revision: integer("revision").notNull(),
  effectiveDate: date("effective_date").notNull(),
  profileEnvelope: text("profile_envelope").notNull(),
  approvedByUserId: integer("approved_by_user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  sourceChangeId: integer("source_change_id").notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, table => [
  uniqueIndex("legal_entity_registration_revision_unique").on(table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId, table.revision),
  uniqueIndex("legal_entity_registration_change_unique").on(table.sourceChangeId),
  index("legal_entity_registration_history_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId, table.effectiveDate),
  foreignKey({ name: "entity_versions_tenant_fk",
    columns: [table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId],
    foreignColumns: [legalEntities.organizationId, legalEntities.id] }),
  foreignKey({ name: "entity_registration_source_request_fk",
    columns: [table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId, table.sourceChangeId],

      legalEntityProfileChangeRequests.legalEntityId, legalEntityProfileChangeRequests.id] }),

/** Maker-checker queue. A change proposal is sealed at rest; APIs return only
 * changed field names, never proposal values or government/bank identifiers.
 */
export const legalEntityProfileChangeRequests = pgTable("legal_entity_profile_change_requests", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  legalEntityId: integer("legal_entity_id").notNull().references(() => legalEntities.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  expectedEntityUpdatedAt: timestamp("expected_entity_updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
  effectiveDate: date("effective_date").notNull(),
  changedFields: jsonb("changed_fields").$type<string[]>().notNull().default([]),
  profileEnvelope: text("profile_envelope").notNull(),
  reason: varchar("reason", { length: 400 }).notNull(),
  status: varchar("status", { length: 24 }).notNull().default("pending_approval"),
  requestedByUserId: integer("requested_by_user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  decidedByUserId: integer("decided_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  decidedAt: timestamp("decided_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, table => [
  unique("entity_profile_request_scope_reference_unique").on(
    table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId, table.id),
  uniqueIndex("legal_entity_profile_one_pending_unique").on(table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId)
    .where(sql`${table.status} = 'pending_approval'`),
  index("legal_entity_profile_request_idx").on(table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId, table.status),
  check("legal_entity_profile_status_check",
    sql`${table.status} in ('pending_approval','approved','rejected')`),
  check("legal_entity_profile_maker_checker_check",
    sql`${table.decidedByUserId} is null or ${table.decidedByUserId} <> ${table.requestedByUserId}`),
  foreignKey({ name: "entity_profile_requests_tenant_fk",
    columns: [table.organizationId, table.legalEntityId],
    foreignColumns: [legalEntities.organizationId, legalEntities.id] }),
]);

/** Explicit reviewer-evidenced source/target liabilities. No automatic
 * transfer/final-pay decision is inferred from continuity of service.
 */
export const legalEntityTransferLiabilityEvidence = pgTable("legal_entity_transfer_liability_evidence", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  employeeId: integer("employee_id").notNull().references(() => employees.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  transferRequestId: integer("transfer_request_id").notNull().references(() => entityTransferRequests.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  fromLegalEntityId: integer("from_legal_entity_id").notNull().references(() => legalEntities.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  toLegalEntityId: integer("to_legal_entity_id").notNull().references(() => legalEntities.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  reviewState: varchar("review_state", { length: 24 }).notNull().default("unresolved"),
  reviewedLiabilityEnvelope: text("reviewed_liability_envelope"),
  reviewedByUserId: integer("reviewed_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  reviewedAt: timestamp("reviewed_at", { withTimezone: true }),

    columns: [table.organizationId, table.employeeId],
    foreignColumns: [employees.organizationId, employees.id] }),
  foreignKey({ name: "entity_transfer_liability_approved_source_fk",
    columns: [table.organizationId, table.transferRequestId, table.employeeId,
      table.fromLegalEntityId, table.toLegalEntityId],
    foreignColumns: [entityTransferRequests.organizationId, entityTransferRequests.id,

/**
 * Opt-in, tenant-owned scheduling policy for WFM roster publish warnings and
 * blockers. No changes to payroll-engine math or prior guardrail semantics.
 */
export const workforceRosterRulePolicies = pgTable("workforce_roster_rule_policies", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  organizationId: integer("organization_id").notNull().unique().references(() => organizations.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  active: boolean("active").notNull().default(true),
  maxDailyMinutes: integer("max_daily_minutes").notNull().default(720),
  maxRollingSevenDayMinutes: integer("max_rolling_seven_day_minutes").notNull().default(2880),
  minRestBetweenShiftsMinutes: integer("min_rest_between_shifts_minutes").notNull().default(660),
  ordinaryDailyMinutes: integer("ordinary_daily_minutes").notNull().default(480),
  approvedOvertimeCapMinutes: integer("approved_overtime_cap_minutes").notNull().default(0),
  enforcementMode: varchar("enforcement_mode", { length: 16 }).notNull().default("block"),
  updatedByUserId: integer("updated_by_user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
}, (table) => [
  index("wfm_roster_rules_org_idx").on(table.organizationId),
  check("wfm_roster_rules_limits_check", sql`(
    ${table.maxDailyMinutes} between 480 and 1440
    and ${table.maxRollingSevenDayMinutes} between 480 and 10080
    and ${table.minRestBetweenShiftsMinutes} between 0 and 1440
    and ${table.ordinaryDailyMinutes} between 480 and 720
    and ${table.approvedOvertimeCapMinutes} between 0 and 10080
    and ${table.enforcementMode} in ('block', 'advisory')
  )`),
]);
